Class Vehicle

java.lang.Object
fleet.Vehicle
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<Vehicle>
public class Vehicle extends Object implements Comparable<Vehicle>
The class represents a vehicle with a license plate, obtained date, make, and mileage, Also has methods for comparison, equality checks, and string representation.

Carly Chick

    • compareTo

      public int compareTo(Vehicle other)
      Compares "this" vehicle to another vehicle (passed in parameter) based on Make and then obtained date.
      Specified by:
      compareTo in interface Comparable<Vehicle>
      Parameters:
      other - the Vehicle to compare to
      Returns:
      0 if both the Make and obtained date are the same; -1 if this Vehicle's Make comes before the other Vehicle's Make alphabetically, or if the Makes are equal but this Vehicle's obtained date is earlier; 1 if this Vehicle's Make comes after the other Vehicle's Make alphabetically, or if the Makes are equal but this Vehicle's obtained date is later; Null pointer exception if the given Vehicle is null
